name: hotspot-billing-agent
description: Enterprise on-site agent connecting MikroTik RouterOS to the Hotspot Billing System (multi-router, auto-reconnect, heartbeat, encrypted token, auto-update).

scripts.prestart: node -e "require('fs').existsSync('dist/index.js')||(console.error('\n[!] dist/index.js haipo. Endesha: npm run build\n'),process.exit(1))"
scripts.build:exe: npm run build && pkg . --targets node18-win-x64 --output build/hotspot-agent.exe
